ChurchStream is free software for **Seventh-day Adventist churches**. It streams the service to YouTube and Facebook and runs the projector — hymns, Bible readings, announcements and names — from one simple control panel that also works on a phone or tablet. **It now runs on Windows and Mac.**

## Download

| Computer | Download |
|---|---|
| **Windows** laptop or PC | **[ChurchStream-win-x64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v0.3.0/ChurchStream-win-x64.zip)** |
| **Mac with an Apple chip** (M1, M2, M3, M4 — 2020 and later) | **[ChurchStream-mac-arm64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v0.3.0/ChurchStream-mac-arm64.zip)** |
| **Mac with an Intel processor** (older Macs) | **[ChurchStream-mac-x64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v0.3.0/ChurchStream-mac-x64.zip)** |

Not sure which Mac you have? Apple menu → **About This Mac**: *Chip: Apple M…* or *Processor: Intel*.

**Windows:** unzip anywhere and double-click **ChurchStream.exe**. The first time, SmartScreen may say *"Windows protected your PC"* — click **More info → Run anyway**.

**Mac:** unzip, move the **ChurchStream** folder to Documents, and double-click **Start ChurchStream.command**. The first time, macOS will say it can't be opened because it isn't from the App Store — open **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**. Allow Terminal to use the camera and microphone, and allow incoming network connections (for phones and tablets). A Terminal window keeps ChurchStream running; close it to stop.

**Updating?** Copy the new files over your old ChurchStream folder; your **ChurchStream-data** folder (settings, songs, services) is kept.

## New in 0.3.0 — ChurchStream for Mac
- **Runs on Mac laptops and desktops** (macOS 13 or later), Apple chips and Intel.
- **Cameras:** the built-in FaceTime camera, USB webcams, HDMI capture devices and an iPhone (Continuity Camera).
- **Apple's hardware video encoder** (VideoToolbox) keeps the laptop cool while streaming.
- **Projector:** with the free Google Chrome, the projector opens full screen on the right screen by itself; otherwise it opens in Safari with instructions.
- **Stays awake** while ChurchStream is running.
- The **user manual** (click **?**) has a Mac section and Mac troubleshooting.

## Recently added (0.2.0)
Volunteer mode, a phone remote, Undo, choosing hymn verses, responsive readings, a printable order of service, projector text options, sound clean-up with mic level and lip-sync, and a built-in user manual.

## Good to know
- Projecting or streaming hymns still under copyright needs your church's **CCLI** licence (and the Streaming Licence for online use). Playing recordings on a live stream can get it muted by YouTube or Facebook.
- ChurchStream is an independent project, not an official product of the Seventh-day Adventist Church.
